lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most change kinds, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have at least two tests.
sign_in hint, home new_flow, choose_path layout, and adoption new_flow can be helpful change types since each produced at least one winning test.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes did not work, showing no clear effect or worse performance across all tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall across most onboarding tests.
Predictions consistently underestimated actual performance for home new_flow and winning sign_in hint tests.

candidates.title: Account Pet Safeguard Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear account security hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links and preserves pets safely across sessions.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven effective in past winning tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet to your secure cloud account so your companion is never reset or lost.

guard.reason: Adds a clear account security hint on sign-in without breaking any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong performance history for sign_in hints and backed by 8 support tickets.

candidates.title: Redesigned Pet Selection Workspace
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a full-bleed workspace with full preview cards and interactive companion choices.
candidates.why: Adoption has a major drop-off (63.3% conversion) and a high mean completion time (1017s), making companion choice visual clarity crucial.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a companion style to bring to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Generation Wait Status Info
candidates.change: Display explicit progress status and desktop tip carousel while waiting for pet companion desktop assets to generate.
candidates.why: The waiting home step has a long duration (median 201s, mean 2336s), creating user drop-off and potential confusion during pet preparation.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Your Desktop...

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with progress info and calm tips, adhering to allowed onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: Past test for home wait_info saw negative lift; low evidence from support.

candidates.title: Companion Personalization Naming Flow
candidates.change: Add interactive pet naming components and preview badge to the companion picking stage.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is high (63.3%); engaging users in naming their companion early builds emotional connection before companion generation.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Complete Desktop Companion Arrival Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a stage layout explaining desktop interaction controls clearly before launch.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to control or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Click and drag to move, or right-click for controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro onboarding screen layout with valid controls guidance.

candidates.score_note: High drop step and support issues, but finish redesigns carry execution risk and high cost.

candidates.title: Grid Layout Companion Path Selector
candidates.change: Change the path selection screen layout to a grid format presenting path options visually.
candidates.why: choose_path layout edits produced winning tests previously, helping users make fast initial selections (median current time is 8s but mean is 514s).

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Path
choose_path.body: Pick how you would like to build your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Updates the layout of choose_path within allowed onboarding redesign scope.

candidates.score_note: choose_path layout edits produced winners previously, moderate cost and lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawning Mascot Waiting Flow
candidates.change: Add a animated pet mascot component and desktop ready progress bar to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Past lessons show home new_flow tests perform well, and visual feedback helps reduce drop-off during the long wait step (mean 2336s).

guard.reason: Adds progress bar and mascot components to the waiting screen as permitted.

candidates.score_note: home new_flow consistently performs well and beats predictions despite drop step being small.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In Account Journey Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place after companion pick and photo upload steps so users customize their pet before authenticating.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (63.3%); allowing users to customize their pet first builds ownership before introducing account creation.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in to take place later in onboarding, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in targets a major funnel step but past test showed negative results.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Controls Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit control hint on the home intro screen detailing tray icon navigation and right-click pet actions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their companion once onboarding finishes.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Access your companion's settings anytime from your system tray or by right-clicking your pet on desktop.

guard.reason: Adds an onboarding hint to home_intro explaining companion desktop controls.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint with support backing, but finish hints previously reduced conversion.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Prep Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated photo preparation advice screen before upload_photos showing formatting and lighting guidance.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect appearance, pointing to poor photo input quality during adoption.

new_photo_prep.headline: Photo Preparation Tips
new_photo_prep.body: Upload a clear, front-facing photo for best 3D desktop companion generation results.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid photo prep advice screen into onboarding without removing existing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step with support evidence, but adding extra screens risks friction.
